strings.undo.title: Go back to the previous preview?
strings.undo.body: This drops the change you just made in this conversation and goes back to the preview before it. The room hasn't changed. A room you already applied can't be undone.
strings.undo.done.title: Undone
strings.undo.done.body: This is the preview before it.
strings.undo.none.title: Nothing to undo
strings.undo.none.body: There are no changes from this conversation yet. A room you already applied can't be undone.
strings.undo.busy.title: {name} is decorating
strings.undo.conflict.title: It was already undone, or the preview changed
strings.undo.conflict.body: We loaded the latest preview. Undo again if you still need to.
strings.undo.err.title: Couldn't undo
strings.undo.err.body: The preview is unchanged. Please try again.
